text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I've been having this scary dream<n>recently... I'm
surrounded by black<n>shadows, and they're all
speaking to<n>me in a language I don't know...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I keep having it... so now, I'm afraidto sleep... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She seems to be really struggling. I<n>wish I could do
something to help.
